name: A2UI
description: Renders agent responses as native interactive UI in web, mobile and Flutter apps, using the open A2UI protocol with renderer and agent SDKs.

skills.name: Render Native UI
skills.description: Renders agent-generated UI as native widgets in React, Angular, Lit, Flutter and SwiftUI apps, with no WebViews or HTML.

skills.name: Stream UI Updates
skills.description: Streams UI descriptions from agent to client for progressive rendering, while bound data updates locally as users interact.

skills.name: Component Catalog Guardrails
skills.description: Restricts what an agent can draw to a developer-defined component catalog and validates every message against a strict schema.

skills.name: Agent SDKs
skills.description: Compiles model output into A2UI messages with Python, TypeScript and Dart agent SDKs that negotiate catalogs and generate prompts.
